title: A sign-in to a second cloud, begun from the welcome sheet while the cloud on file had failed to open, returned after that cloud's open landed; the in-flight-only check passed, so connect switched clouds and merged the phone's record into the second cloud
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift connect refuses a different cloud whenever one is connected, before keep or any file write (US-25 AC11l); the AC11j in-flight clause is deleted, subsumed. CloudSyncTests testASignInLeftOverFromTheWelcomeSheetCannotSwitchTheOpenCloud_US25_AC11l and testASecondFirstConnectReturningAfterTheFirstOpenedIsRefused_US25_AC11l (failed first). Found in review of PR 1328. S3's CloudConnection union should make it true by construction and delete the guard
